info.longBusinessSummary: O-I Glass, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells glass containers to food and beverage manufacturers in the Americas, Europe, and internationally. The company produces glass containers for alcoholic beverages, including beer, flavored malt beverages, spirits, and wine. It is also involved in the production of glass packaging for various food items, soft drinks, teas, juices, and pharmaceuticals. In addition, the company offers glass containers in a range of sizes, shapes, and colors. It sells its products directly to customers under annual or multi-year supply agreements, as well as through distributors. The company was formerly known as Owens-Illinois, Inc. and changed its name to O-I Glass, Inc. in December 2019. O-I Glass, Inc. was founded in 1903 and is based in Perrysburg, Ohio.
